note: Substrate §4.2, the ignored-root smuggling case — the one fixture in this kit where a PASSING digest check is the failure. This package carries an executable `.git/hooks/post-checkout`; because `learner-public.v1` ignores `.git/` at hashing, it digest-verifies to exactly `tree-golden.json`'s constant. Nothing about the digest is wrong, and nothing about the digest can save you: the hook fires the moment the learner's own git machinery runs in the materialized workspace. The control is the separate fail-closed refusal — a `jinn.harness-state.v1` package containing ANY profile-ignored root is rejected at materialization, on EVERY path (Workspace Provisioner included, not only `jinn checkpoint install`). C5 consumes this fixture on the provisioner path; this kit asserts both halves here so the two facts cannot be separated: digest EQUAL, materialization REFUSED.
